description: One call that gives a chat client (ChatGPT, Claude) a whole TaScan project in about 2,000 words: the project, every task list with task counts, open decisions and questions, the last 5 coordination cycles with verdicts and spend, the latest 5 receipts, and total spend — returned as Markdown (capped at 12,000 chars). Read tier. Use it before asking a human to paste anything.
name: tascan_project_digest
